evidence: CVE.org record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-76207 has cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn) and describes remember-me tokens issued before 2FA completes, then replayed for a fully authenticated session; CWE-304; affected semver 0 to <4.1.7, 4.1.7 unaffected.

Vendor advisory https://github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ/security/advisories/GHSA-hvj7-4fmg-53cr (linked from GHSA-jvxm-3fc5-8pjr) names the two cooperating paths: CurrentUser::login() issues the remember-me token after password success while deferring the session for twofactor_enabled users, and getFromCookie() treats a matching cookie as loggedIn=true with no 2FA check. GHSA-jvxm-3fc5-8pjr has withdrawn_at=null.

At BIC d60a0f52368b491e401b4cf00f59f45d34d39403, phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/User/CurrentUser.php login() wraps session creation in if ($this->getUserData('twofactor_enabled') != 1) at lines 191-196, then issues and stores the remember-me cookie unconditionally at lines 199-207. getFromCookie() at lines 564-584 loads that cookie, calls updateSessionId(true), sets loggedIn=true, and saveToSession() with no twofactor_enabled test. The same unguarded issuance-plus-cookie-login pairing is present at tag 4.1.6 (58c1d7f2fa36f7074664fc6d862afee0ca8bcc89) lines 178-192 and 577-599.
